 Today, I got an email newsletter with information about some candy recalls; reminding me to check more sources as well. As a result, I decided to do this diary – being that it is the day before Halloween. I’m posting this not to scare but to share; to inform with some various sources, information about candy recalls for safety reasons. Candy is not just for Halloween, so its good to know this for any time. Have fun, enjoy candy but be safe!
 Some Candy Recalls as of October 30, 2026:
 This is what I’ve found so far. You are welcome to add more in the comments if you wish.
 Recalls up to this date of October 30, 2026 (reason for my “as of” notation), therefore some of these recalls were made months ago. If you’re not sure about a product, its best to not use it and do not distribute it to trick or treaters during Halloween (better to be safe than sorry). 
 List of Halloween Products, Candy Recalled Ahead of October 31 – Newsweek 
 https://www.newsweek.com/halloween-products-treats-recalled-ahead-of-october-31-what-parents-should-know-12627281 
 Halloween Chocolatey Eyeballs sold at TJ Maxx, Marshalls recalled 
 According to the USA Today news article published on September 1, 2026, Crystal Temptations recalled its Chocolatey Eyeballs Halloween candy: 
 The candy was sold at Marshalls, TJ Maxx, Home Goods and Sierra Trading Post in the following states:
 Arizona
 California
 Conneticut
 Georgia
 Indiana
 Massachusetts
 Nevada
 New Jersey
 North Carolina
 Ohio
 Texas
 Virginia
 Wyoming
 https://www.usatoday.com/story/money/consumer-protection/recalls-alerts/2026/09/01/halloween-chocolatey-eyeball-candy-recalled-tj-maxx-marshalls/91560082007 
 Black Doctor website: their target audience is Black but their HEALTH information can help EVERYONE. Read:
 This is a newsletter that I receive periodically via email from the Black Doctor website; I think their website started during the COVID pandemic (at least, that’s when I became aware of them and started receiving their newsletters) by some Black doctors who wanted to share truthful information to the public online – especially targeting Black people, but not limited to or exclusively for – due to the fact that many Black people understandably did not trust the information at the time (sometimes trusting the wrong sources, information and not the right information, especially regarding the vaccines for COVID). While it targets a Black audience, the Black Doctor website provides all kinds of health information that is useful and beneficial TO ANYONE regardless of race, etc. Their information below also includes their articles on the candy recall; the “hangover” from too much candy and its effects on the body as well as the candies to avoid (based on its sugar amount, etc.).
 Black Doctor on Candy Recalls: 
 WARNING: Millions of Candy & Chocolate Recalled Sold at Popular Stores – BlackDoctor – Where Culture Meets Care 
 WARNING: Millions of Candy & Chocolate Recalled Sold at Popular Stores 
 Black Doctor on candies to avoid due to its high in calories, sugar: 
 Avoid These High Calorie, High Sugar Candies – BlackDoctor – Where Culture Meets Care 
 Avoid These High Calorie, High Sugar Candies 
 Black Doctor on the “hangover” some feel after too much Halloween candy, its effects on the body: 
 The Halloween Hangover: What Candy and Lost Sleep Can Do to Your Body – BlackDoctor – Where Culture Meets Care 
 The Halloween Hangover: What Candy and Lost Sleep Can Do to Your Body 
 Thank you for reading. Be safe!
